description: Top-level index for Fusion 360 CAD-side (Design workspace) operations: sketch tools, 3D feature creation, modify ops, surface ops, mesh ops. CAD-side parity to the existing CAM-side Fusion360FunctionIndexEngine. Consumed by Fusion360CADFunctionIndexEngine for lookup, parameter discovery, and AI orchestration of CAD generation.

modules.description: 2D sketch creation and editing: Line, Rectangle (3 variants), Circle (5 variants), Polygon (3 variants), Arc (3 variants), Ellipse, Spline (2 variants), Slot (4 variants), Conic, Point, Project/Intersect/Project-to-Surface, Mirror, Offset, Trim/Extend/Break, Scale, Sketch Dimensions (linear/angular/radial/diameter), Geometric Constraints (13 types), Construction Geometry toggle.

3D feature creation: solid sweeps (Extrude, Revolve, Sweep, Loft), thin features (Rib, Web), holes/threads (Hole with 5 head variants, Thread with ANSI/ISO/UNJ standards), modify-by-removal (Shell, Draft), patterns (Linear/Circular/On-Path/On-Sketch), Mirror, Boolean (Combine, Split Body, Boundary Fill). 18 operations.

Post-feature modify and construction operations: edge filleting (4 types), chamfering (3 types), Press Pull (4 inferred modes), rigid Move (5 transform types), Scale (uniform / non-uniform), construction Plane (7 variants), Axis (5 variants), Point (8 variants), and Section Analysis (single + multi-section). 9 operations.

Surface modeling: gap-filling (Patch), connectivity (Stitch / Unstitch), boundary modification (Trim Surface / Extend Surface), normal correction (Reverse Normal), offset (Offset Surface), and surface-to-solid conversion (Thicken). Boundary Fill lives in feature_operations to avoid duplication. 8 operations.

Mesh modeling: import (Insert Mesh from OBJ/STL/3MF), conversion (Convert to BRep), decimation (Reduce — count/percentage/deviation modes), smoothing (Smooth — Laplacian + Taubin λ-μ), healing (Repair — fill holes / fix non-manifold / merge duplicates), splitting (Plane Cut), local edits (Erase and Fill). 7 operations.

Assembly modeling: kinematic Joint (7 motion types: rigid/revolute/slider/cylindrical/pin_slot/planar/ball), As-Built Joint (from current geometry), Rigid Group (lock components together), Component From Bodies, Component Insert (copy or derive), Component Ground, Motion Link (gear/rack/leadscrew ratios), Drive Joints (kinematic animation), Motion Study (keyframe + dynamic simulation with gravity/friction/contact), Contact Set (collision pairs). 10 operations.

Sheet Metal toolspace within Design workspace — Fusion's rule-driven sheet metal. 13 operations: rule management (Sheet Metal Rule), body conversion (Convert to Sheet Metal), base creation (Flange in 3 modes — edge/profile/edge_distance, Tab from closed profile), edge features (Bend at edge or between faces, Hem in 5 types — closed/open/teardrop/rolled/double, Insert Bend at sketch line), separation (Rip), unfold/refold workflow, sheet-metal-aware Cut (with Affect-Bend + Through-Bend modes), Bend Order Edit for press-brake sequencing, and Flat Pattern emission with full annotation control (centerlines / extent lines / radius / direction / K-factor in BOM).
